title: Miley Cyrus weds drummer Maxx Morando in California
summary: The 33-year-old singer announces the marriage on Instagram on Sunday, with the wedding photographs captioned simply 'M + M' and '11.21.26'

blocks.text: COUPLE. Miley Cyrus and Maxx Morando attend the world premiere for the television show "Hannah Montana 20th Anniversary Special" in Los Angeles, California, US, March 23, 2026.
The 33-year-old singer announces the marriage on Instagram on Sunday, with the wedding photographs captioned simply 'M + M' and '11.21.26'
Grammy-winning pop star Miley Cyrus married her longtime partner, drummer Maxx Morando, in a private ceremony in California, with black-and-white pictures of the event posted on social media.
The 33-year-old singer announced the marriage on Instagram on Sunday, with the wedding photographs captioned simply “M + M” and “11.21.26.”
Cyrus wore a backless white silk gown, while Morando, 28, appeared in a classic black suit and white shirt at Saturday’s event.
People magazine and Entertainment Tonight were among the first to report the news. Representatives of the couple did not immediately respond to a Reuters request for comment.
Cyrus and Morando reportedly married in Palm Springs, a month after performing “Let’s Get Married” together at the Hollywood Bowl, a song that features in Cyrus’ latest studio album, Bass Persuades.
Cyrus and Morando have been together for about five years. They met on blind date in 2021, Cyrus told British Vogue in an interview.
“Well, it was blind for me and not really for him,” the singer said in 2023. “I thought, ‘The worst that can happen is I leave.’”
In December, Cyrus spoke of her engagement to the drummer during an appearance on ABC’s “Good Morning America”.
Morando is the drummer for Liily, a Los Angeles-based alternative rock band affiliated with Atlantic Records, the band says on its website.
The “Flowers” singer was previously married to Australian actor Liam Hemsworth, who filed for divorce in Los Angeles in 2019. – Rappler.com
